source.derives_from: NONE (checked; this is the upstream repository)
source.inspection_mode: public source and metadata read as text only; no install, import, pickle load or third-party execution

fork_graph.sample_order: GitHub forks endpoint sorted by stargazers
fork_graph.coverage_limit: The 100-row metadata sample is not a 326-fork source audit. Six source compares were inspected: every nonzero-star fork returned at the head of the endpoint plus the freshest 2026 rows selected this run. Residual forks remain open.

evidence: gplearn/genetic.py constructs a generation through the joblib Parallel call before appending population to self._programs
run_details_ is appended only after the complete population has returned and fitness has been calculated
the fit loop contains no exception-to-terminal-outcome path
findings.economic_disposition: REJECT gplearn run_details_ and warm_start state as a candidate-conservation ledger. An interruption inside a generation loses that generation and records no failed trial identities.

evidence: warm_start reuses in-memory self._programs from a prior completed fit call
the official advanced documentation delegates persistence to user-managed pickle after fit
issue 279 requested autosave because interrupted multi-hour fits lose prior work; the maintainer suggested an outer loop combining warm start and pickle rather than an in-loop durable ledger
findings.economic_disposition: KEEP only the outer-loop idea as weak convergence on generation-bounded recovery. REFUSE direct pickle-as-ledger transfer: it does not prewrite candidate identities, type failures, checksum state or atomically separate controller recovery from immutable trial history.

evidence: six selected fork compares contained no checkpoint or autosave implementation
the two divergent forks changed functions/parser/operator behavior rather than durable trial accounting
four selected forks were behind or identical to upstream
findings.economic_disposition: NEGATIVE SCREEN. Do not spend implementation budget importing a fork. The existing desk repair remains append-before-evaluate candidate rows plus typed terminal outcomes and atomic checksum-valid controller checkpoints in a separate artifact.

mt5_translation.disposition: These are research-integrity mechanisms over every terminal-enumerated Fusion candidate, not market features. No symbol, direction, timeframe or alpha was invented.
mt5_translation.future_candidate_cost_contract: Any later market candidate must bind PIT bid/ask bars, symbol-native spread, commission, realised slippage and partial-fill markout, swap, contract specification, code/config/data fingerprints and the canonical ten-gate certificate.
